Economy · India

Gold and Silver Prices Rise on Global Cues

Gold prices increased for the second consecutive day, with international rates influenced by a weakening US dollar. Silver also saw a rise, gaining Rs 3,500 per kilogram in domestic markets. Investors are awaiting US inflation data for indications on the Federal Reserve's future policy decisions, amidst ongoing geopolitical tensions. MCX prices showed mixed trends, with silver gaining and gold declining.
